title: Zoology :Reproductive System Flashcards
description: Key facts from TNPSC Group II Zoology Reproductive System Chapter

cards.q: What are the two modes of reproduction?
In which type of cells does asexual reproduction take place?
What is the mode of reproduction in Hydra and Yeast?
What is Syngamy?
cards.a: Fusion of male and female cells.

cards.q: What is the difference between Viviparous and Oviparous animals?
cards.a: Viviparous: embryo develops inside female body (most mammals). Oviparous: fertilized egg develops outside body (reptiles, birds).

cards.q: Which animal has the longest gestation period among those listed?

Who discovered female ovary cells?

What is the weight of the prostate gland?

What are the three parts of the male urethra?
cards.a: Prostatic urethra, Membranous urethra, and Spongy (Penile) urethra.

cards.q: What are the three masses of erectile tissue in the penis?
cards.a: Right and Left Corpora Cavernosa and the median Corpus Spongiosum Penis.

cards.q: What is the expanded end of the Corpus Spongiosum Penis called?
What is the swollen base of the Glans Penis called?

How many oocytes are present at birth?
Approximately how many oocytes undergo ovulation during a woman's reproductive years?
What happens to the corpus luteum if pregnancy does not occur?
cards.a: It degenerates after 10-12 days and becomes the corpus albicans.

cards.q: What is the female copulatory organ?

cards.a: No, it has no established function.
